.github/workflows/pages.yml.before:
name: Deploy Crate Diggin to GitHub Pages
# v14.0 publication retry; push triggers a fresh deployment
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pages-pr-validation-{0}-{1}', github.run_id, github.run_attempt) || 'github-pages' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install Pillow markdown-it-py==4.0.0
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y fonts-dejavu-core
      - name: Restore verified image encoding cache
        id: image-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/cratediggin-image-delivery-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-image-delivery-${{ hashFiles('image_delivery.py') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-image-delivery-${{ hashFiles('image_delivery.py') }}-
      - name: Validate JavaScript and generate site
        env:
          SITE_URL: https://djnaoyaman.github.io/cratediggin
        run: |
          python build.py
          node --check dist/app.js
          node --check dist/art.js
          node --check dist/playlist.js
          node --check dist/filters.js
          node --check dist/timeline.js
          git diff --exit-code -- src templates
          python scripts/audit_editorial_depth.py
          python scripts/verify_catalog_sources.py
          python scripts/verify_renewal_preservation.py
          python scripts/verify_requested_four.py
          python scripts/verify_requested_six.py
          python scripts/verify_artifacts_credits.py
          python scripts/verify_timeline_explorer.py
          node scripts/verify_catalog_explorer.cjs
          python scripts/verify_requested_two.py
          python scripts/verify_compact_list_dilla.py
          python scripts/verify_ini_japan_media.py
          python scripts/verify_editorial_remediation.py
          python scripts/verify_producer_photos.py
          python scripts/verify_browser_tools.py
          python scripts/verify_premier_feature.py
          python scripts/verify_home_install_direct.py
          node scripts/verify_home_install_direct.cjs
          node scripts/verify_gallery_routes.cjs
          node scripts/verify_opening_selection.cjs
          python scripts/verify_contextual_opening.py
          python scripts/test_editorial_uniqueness.py
          python scripts/verify_editorial_uniqueness.py
          python scripts/verify_essay_reference_output.py
          node scripts/verify_essay_references.cjs
          node scripts/verify_analytics_privacy.cjs
          node scripts/verify_renewal.cjs
      - name: Save verified image encoding cache
        if: steps.image-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/cratediggin-image-delivery-cache
          key: ${{ steps.image-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: Audit catalog metadata and link integrity
        run: |
          python scripts/audit_catalog.py
          python scripts/verify_discovery.py
          python scripts/verify_work_types.py
          node scripts/verify_undated_works.cjs
          python scripts/verify_live_video_works.py
          python scripts/verify_donuts_album.py
          node scripts/verify_album_player.cjs
          node scripts/verify_visible_art.cjs
          node scripts/verify_art_modes.cjs
          node scripts/verify_art_resume_intent.cjs
          node scripts/verify_navigation_hotfix.cjs
          python scripts/verify_image_delivery.py
          node scripts/verify_player_presentation.cjs
          python scripts/verify_player_presentation.py
          node scripts/verify_player_intent.cjs
          python scripts/verify_mix_works.py
          python scripts/verify_mix_enrichment.py
          python scripts/verify_graffiti_og.py
          python scripts/verify_url_migration.py
          python scripts/verify_profile_notes.py
          python scripts/verify_public_copy.py
          python scripts/verify_reader_copy_cleanup.py
          python scripts/verify_shadow_editorial.py
          python scripts/verify_common_celebrate.py
          python scripts/verify_make_her_say.py
          python scripts/verify_section_reference_units.py
          python scripts/verify_section_reference_output.py .
          python scripts/verify_social_sharing_static.py
          python scripts/test_revision_dates.py
          node scripts/verify_work_labels.cjs
          node scripts/verify_inline_player.cjs
          node scripts/verify_player_readiness.cjs
          node scripts/verify_listening_shelves.js
          node scripts/verify_producer_features.js
          node scripts/verify_feature_editorials.js
          node scripts/verify_catalog_views.js
          node scripts/verify_graffiti.cjs
          node scripts/verify_playlist_storage.cjs
          node scripts/verify_ux_motion.cjs
          python scripts/verify_kiyo_import.py
          python -m py_compile scripts/audit_catalog.py build.py
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import json
          root = Path('dist')
          data = json.loads(Path('tracks.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          assert {p.stem for p in (root/'tracks').glob('*.html') if p.name!='index.html'} == {t['id'] for t in data}, 'Generated song HTML IDs mismatch'
          assert (root/'tracks'/'index.html').exists(), 'Static song index missing'
          assert len(list((root/'tracks').glob('*.md'))) == len(data), 'Generated Markdown page count mismatch'
          assert len(list((root/'og').glob('*.jpg'))) == len(data), 'Generated social image count mismatch'
          html = (root/'index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          assert '/cratediggin/tracks/' in html, 'Project Pages links missing base path'
          assert '"//cratediggin/' not in html, 'Broken protocol-relative Pages URLs'
          assert 'src="/cratediggin/tracks.js' in html, 'Track data script URL incorrect'
          assert 'src="/cratediggin/app.js' in html, 'Player script URL incorrect'
          assert 'href="/cratediggin/apple-touch-icon-vinyl.png?v=original-20261016"' in html, 'Vinyl touch icon URL missing'
          assert html.count('rel="apple-touch-icon"') == 1, 'Duplicate Apple touch icon tags'
          assert (root/'apple-touch-icon-vinyl.png').exists(), 'Vinyl touch icon not generated'
          artist_pages = [p for p in (root/'artists').glob('*.html') if p.name!='index.html']
          assert artist_pages, 'No crawlable artist pages generated'
          sitemap = (root/'sitemap.xml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          assert all('/artists/'+p.name in sitemap for p in artist_pages), 'Artist page missing from sitemap'
          assert 'ARTIST INDEX' in html, 'Artist links missing from static home HTML'
          assert '/cratediggin/artists/' in html, 'Crawlable artist links missing from homepage'
          assert any('/cratediggin/artists/' in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in (root/'tracks').glob('*.html')), 'Crawlable song-to-artist links missing'
          assert '## Artists' in (root/'llms.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'AI discovery artist index missing'
          assert 'DIG DEEPER' in (root/'app.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'Deep-dive UI missing'
          assert '制作の背景：サンプラーの制約が音楽になった' in (root/'tracks.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), 'Deep-dive source content missing'
          import json
          tracks=json.loads((Path('tracks.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          deepdives=json.loads((Path('editorial_deepdives.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          pe={t['title'] for t in tracks if t['artist']=='Public Enemy'}
          covered={d['title'] for d in deepdives if d['artist']=='Public Enemy' and len(d['sections'])>=3}
          assert pe == covered, f'Public Enemy editorial coverage mismatch: {pe ^ covered}'
          gs={t['title'] for t in tracks if t['artist']=='Gang Starr'}
          gs_covered={d['title'] for d in deepdives if d['artist']=='Gang Starr' and len(d['sections'])>=3}
          assert gs and gs==gs_covered, f'Gang Starr editorial coverage mismatch: {gs ^ gs_covered}'
          shadow_ids=set(json.loads(Path('scripts/shadow_existing_depth_ids.json').read_text()))
          assert shadow_ids <= {t['id'] for t in tracks}
          shadow={t['title'] for t in tracks if t['id'] in shadow_ids}
          shadow_covered={d['title'] for d in deepdives if d['artist']=='DJ Shadow' and len(d['sections'])>=4}
          assert shadow and shadow <= shadow_covered, f'DJ Shadow coverage mismatch: {shadow ^ shadow_covered}'
          research=json.loads(Path('dj_shadow_sample_research.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          assert len(research)>=6 and sum(len(x['samples']) for x in research)>=13
          js=(Path('dist')/'tracks.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          assert 'researchedSamples' in js and all(any(s.get('research') for s in t['samples']) for t in tracks if t['artist']=='DJ Shadow' and t['title'] in {e['title'] for e in research})
          assert 'dj-shadow-the-number-song' in (root/'tracks.js').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          print('Generated pages, social cards, URLs and Number Song verified')
          PY
      - name: Verify listening shelves in desktop and mobile browsers
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          mkdir -p /tmp/crate-preview
          ln -s "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist" /tmp/crate-preview/cratediggin
          python -m http.server 8765 --directory /tmp/crate-preview >/tmp/crate-preview.log 2>&1 &
          server=$!
          trap 'kill "$server"' EXIT
          node scripts/verify_artifacts_credits_browser.cjs
          node scripts/verify_feature_swipe_browser.cjs
          player_intent_status=0

          node scripts/verify_player_intent_browser.cjs || player_intent_status=$?

          node scripts/verify_renewal_browser.cjs || renewal_status=$?

  deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Reject stale or non-main deployment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/main" || ! "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Only the current main commit may deploy."
            exit 1
          fi
          remote_line="$(timeout 60 git ls-remote --exit-code "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" refs/heads/main)"
          read -r remote_sha remote_ref extra <<< "$remote_line"
          if [[ "$remote_ref" != "refs/heads/main" || -n "${extra:-}" || "$remote_sha" != "$GITHUB_SHA" || "$remote_line" == *$'\n'* ]]; then
            echo "::error::The deployment commit is not the current main commit."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
